mission: LÉLU 2.1 — geometry fidelity and mathematical validation
observed: voxel/tubes-high/tubes-medium/tubes-low hair builds all report 375460 occupancy cells (digest 15999). Tubes replace the hair mesh only: high spends 426650 triangles where the voxel shell spends 540508.
studied: Swept-tube surfaces with parallel-transport frames (Bergou et al. 2008), elliptical cross-sections, taper and closed ends; why a surface representation is not the same thing as an occupancy decision.
question: Can her hair look like distinct curls without changing what ASRE/NRE believe she occupies?
hypothesis: A mesh swap changes appearance but not occupancy, if occupancy is decided before the surface is built.
method: Build voxel, tubes-high, tubes-medium and tubes-low from the same roots; hash the SparseVoxelGrid cell set in each build; compare the hashes, then compare triangle counts and file sizes.
results: Identical occupancy in all four variants (375460 cells, digest 15999); hair triangles 540508 → 426650 → 52920; strands 1219, baby hairs 120, diameter CV 0.427.

evidence.note: asserts the cell counts and digests are equal

learned: Occupancy is an authority decision taken before the surface exists, so presentation can improve without re-opening ASRE/NRE. That is the property that makes visual work safe.
limitations: Invariance is asserted for these four builds; a new root set needs its own comparison.
Root placement was carried over from the voxel roots — see the floating-root entry for what that did not guarantee.
applications: Hair can gain LODs, breaks and baby hairs without invalidating spatial authority.
The same pattern applies to any component whose surface is presentation-only.
nextQuestions: Do the 54 roots beyond 4 mm come from the face cut, the normal lift, or the root set?
Does the crown stay covered at the medium LOD?
answers: Can her hair look like distinct curls without changing what ASRE/NRE believe she occupies?

assumptions.statement: occupancy is independent of the surface representation
root placement is carried over unchanged from the voxel roots
